thread:
Mira: Quick tactical flash — scaling, governance, and one ask for next week.
Mira: TL;DR: regional outage last Friday, durable fixes in staging, new retention policy drafts, and a short freeze around the private beta launch.
Alex: saw the incident report. thanks for the summary. can infra take the lead on the rollback plan?
Lina: yes — infra runs the rollback plan. current plan: 2-step canary, traffic steer, db read replicas warmed.
Zoe: security checked the rollback playbook. no fresh creds required. postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow.
Mira: priorities for leadership: 1) hit P99 latency target 350ms for hosted API by EOD next Wednesday. 2) reduce inference unit cost by 20% over Q2. 3) finalise data-retention policy for Private.
Sam: for P99 target I'm allocating 2 more instances to the realtime pool and enabling the new batching heuristic tomorrow at 09:00 PT.
Alex: will coordinate model variant routing to avoid noisy neighbors. adding canary to Dedicated pools.
Taylor: product note — we'll freeze UX surface changes during the beta week (May 3–7). Keep config-only deploys ok.
Mira: governance ask — org leads please review the draft "Governance & Rollout Playbook" (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/governance-playbook) and comment by Friday.
Lina: also, retention policy: proposed default 90 days for request logs, 365 days for billing. asking legal to sign off by EOD Thursday.
Zoe: encryption and KMS integration checklist updated in the doc. please ensure any Private rollout uses customer KMS.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: enabling batching-heuristic v2 at 2024-05-01T16:00Z — will notify on progress.
Mira: staffing — hiring update: offer to senior infra engineer accepted (joining May 20), interviewing two SRE candidates this week.
Alex: Ops heads: ping me with any capacity shortfalls. I'll re-prioritize sprint tasks.
Taylor: anything else on SLAs? customers asked for 99.95% availability guarantee for Dedicated. legal wants a review.
Mira: yes — please draft SLA note and risk annex. we'll discuss in Monday's exec sync.
Lina: noted. I'll prepare an incident readiness checklist and a proposed maintenance window schedule.
Sam: quick FYI: temp mitigation reduced error rate by 80% in region eu-west-1 last Friday. logs attached:
```
ERROR 503 latency spike 1.2s - trace id: abc123
CPU 93% on g4dn.xlarge
```
Alex: thanks — small asks: keep any config toggles behind flags. rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation.
Mira: great. small wins: cost optimization runs saved ~11% this month; keep the momentum. any blockers? :eyes: 
Taylor: blocked on legal signoff for retention policy, otherwise clear.
Zoe: no blockers from security.
Alex: engineering has a doc with rollout steps, will share link in #eng.
Mira: thanks everyone — short ask: org leads, leave feedback on the playbook by Friday. I'll call a 15m sync Friday 10:30 PT if needed. :wave:
Sam: ack.
Lina: ack.
ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem scheduled 2024-05-02T15:00Z in #postmortems.
